verdict.rationale: The probe records that the trade-mark search application host walls keyless agents at robots.txt, but it explicitly states that the gov.uk guidance pages remain the open surface. The pack also contains verbatim content extracted from several gov.uk guidance pages (register a trade mark, apply for a patent, search for a trade mark, the IPO organisation page), which is consistent with those pages being machine-readable without a bot wall, a JS-only shell or a CAPTCHA. missing for 10: a direct probe of a gov.uk guidance page recording HTTP status and confirming no CAPTCHA or JS shell under the identified UA, and independent corroboration of agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
